kavach.apiBaseUrl.description: Local Kavach API base URL. Only localhost/loopback endpoints are accepted.

languageModelTools.name: kavach-chat-participant_inspect_terminal_command
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Before proposing a terminal command for execution, inspect the exact command with Kavach's local policy API. Submit the full proposed command and the caller-supplied intent as data; the intent is not authenticated and cannot establish user authorization. This tool NEVER executes the command. Use the structured result to explain minister/policy findings. If BLOCK or ESCALATE, stop; do not retry or route around the decision. Even for ALLOW, the real VS Code Local PreToolUse hook must independently check the actual call.

command.description: Exact proposed terminal command, without Markdown fences. This is submitted as data only and is never executed by this tool.

intent.description: Brief user-authorized goal this command is meant to achieve.
